name: Lintmoth
description:
A pale moth spun from laundry lint, smelling of starch. It settles on your collar when called.

{key.summon} calls it to you. Costs {cost} summon charge. It wards you against harm and sharpens your senses for {seconds} seconds.

text.callResult: {spirit} settles on you · warded and keen · −{cost} summon
